query: INSERT INTO quotes.quote_facts (job_id, business_id, trip_fee, parts, permit, may_change, spanish, job_type, recorded_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9) ON CONFLICT (job_id, business_id) DO UPDATE SET trip_fee = EXCLUDED.trip_fee, parts = EXCLUDED.parts, permit = EXCLUDED.permit, may_change = EXCLUDED.may_change, spanish = EXCLUDED.spanish, job_type = EXCLUDED.job_type, recorded_at = EXCLUDED.recorded_at
